named_gap: Transfer of qualified command-response learning into closed-loop tracking
mechanism: No fitting. Compare the saved full_mse_6000 and paired_6000 raw research SequenceModels with the same anticipatory controller, ten real history-fill holds, captured32-to64 planning, fixed five-step horizon, solver budget and identical borrowed covariance.
comparison: Eight fresh matched initial-condition seeds118–125. Each arm uses its own trajectory, observed history and warm starts. Forecast-only versus paired supervision includes their frozen checkpoint-selection rules; both have the same architecture, data and6000-step training budget. Previous two-hold oracle trials are context, not a matched comparator.
preflight_meaning: 1176 parent/arm/origin/tape witnesses; each checks both precision paths, chronological/reset and direct-history parity, native polar geometry, and all15 centered finite-difference coordinates. This is seam support, not task scoring.

report.experimental_units: Eight paired initial-condition seeds; 2,248 correlated trajectory samples per arm.
report.stopping_meaning: Iteration limits alone are not reliability failures; returned residuals and raw backend messages are reported separately.
report.interpretation: Same fixed research architecture, training data, initialization, minibatch draws and6000-step budget. Compare the already selected forecast-only checkpoint5700 with paired-response checkpoint5900. No refit, update, reselection or recalibration. This tests the paired-objective plus checkpoint-selection package in closed loop.
report.timing_meaning: Run arms serially on one pinned host, prewarm each on discarded equilibrium transitions, reset all per-trial state/records. Synchronized outer solve duration covers seed selection, precision setup, optimization, result materialization and both extra64 audits. Report this instrumented decision latency plus tick/elapsed time, median/p95/max and >50ms counts; no real-time or equal-compute claim. Report accepted iterations for all arms, L-BFGS-B objective/seed/audit counters, float32 seed selection and extra64 audits separately. Wall measurements never influence commands and cannot be authenticated by deterministic replay.

independent_analysis.meaning: Separate NumPy implementation reconstructs references, task counts, paired RMSEs, returned full-gradient residuals, work counters and descriptive timing reductions.

initial_remote_core.reason: Unit-test expected exact equality of compiled and eager float32 quaternion observation values; CPU fusion differed by3.7e-9. Corrected expected observation helper to the same compiled numerical path. No experiment source or threshold changed; no saved-model measurement preceded correction.

interpretation: Both generic learned means satisfy the declared95% application on every one of eight trials; each obtains2248/2248 simultaneous lateral/altitude tolerance samples. The task is feasible without oracle dynamics.

Paired supervision improves lateral RMSE17.5% and altitude RMSE46.1% by paired geometric ratios, and reduces optimizer work. The forecast-only mean already meets the same application, so pairing is not shown necessary for this task.

The frozen material-progress flag remains false: pooled tolerance gain iszero at the baseline ceiling, and lateral ratio0.82497 exceeds the declared0.8 bound. Application qualification is a separate passed condition. No gate is rewritten.

Median instrumented solve latency is13.62ms forecast-only and10.59ms paired on this host.15/2480 and13/2480 solves respectively exceed50ms; unpaced simulation with no deadline enforcement is not a real-time qualification.

Iteration limits remain:1669 forecast-only and134 paired returned residuals exceed0.002. Neither arm has a backend failure, fallback, nonfinite evaluation, bounds violation or returned rotation-geometry violation.

No public learner/controller promotion, arbitrary-system claim, measured candidate uncertainty, hardware/disturbance qualification or live-update success follows. Training used simulator branch data; the exact adopted v3 archive has not been evaluated with this controller.
next_named_gap: Readiness of the saved adopted public v3 learner under the now-qualified anticipatory controller, before changing its recipe or assuming paired supervision is required.
